name: MonarchDuplicatePanel
title: DuplicatePanel
summary: Saved records that look like the one being created or viewed, why each one matched, and buttons to open, merge or dismiss each one.
whenToUse: Under a create form when the entered data matches existing records, or on a record screen to list likely duplicates.
whenNotToUse: To block saving, use form validation with an error. To merge two records field by field, use a merge screen; start it from onMerge.
api: @Composable fun MonarchDuplicatePanel(matches: List<MonarchDuplicateMatch>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, variant: MonarchDuplicatePanelVariant = MonarchDuplicatePanelVariant.Hint, footer: String? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, onOpen: ((MonarchDuplicateMatch) -> Unit)? = null, onMerge: ((MonarchDuplicateMatch) -> Unit)? = null, onDismiss: ((MonarchDuplicateMatch) -> Unit)? = null, title: String? = null, openLabel: String? = null, mergeLabel: String? = null, dismissLabel: String? = null)
class MonarchDuplicateMatch(val id: String, val title: String, val kind: String? = null, val reasons: List<String> = emptyList(), val detail: String? = null, val score: Float? = null)

options.name: matches
options.description: The likely duplicates, in order. Nothing is drawn when empty.

options.name: variant
options.description: Hint: a warning box under a form. Panel: a plain section.

options.name: footer
options.description: A closing line, for example "You can still create it."

options.name: icon
options.description: An icon before the heading of the hint. Decorative; Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: onOpen
options.description: Adds an Open button to each match. The app navigates.

options.name: onMerge
options.description: Adds a Merge button to each match.

options.name: onDismiss
options.description: Adds a "Not a duplicate" button to each match. The app removes the match.

options.name: title
options.description: The heading. null uses monarch_duplicatepanel_title_one or _other by the number of matches.

options.name: openLabel
options.description: Label of the Open buttons. null uses monarch_duplicatepanel_open.

options.name: mergeLabel
options.description: Label of the Merge buttons. null uses monarch_duplicatepanel_merge.

options.name: dismissLabel
options.description: Label of the dismiss buttons. null uses monarch_duplicatepanel_dismiss.

states.name: several matches
states.description: The heading is plural, with one card per match.

states.name: no matches
states.description: Nothing is drawn and no space is taken.

appearance: The hint is a box in the warning subtle background with the warning border and a heading in the strong warning color; the panel has no box and a heading in the default text color. Each match is a MonarchCard on the surface color with the name in strong body text, kind and score as neutral badges, and reasons and detail in muted caption text.
platformNotes: The web takes an href per match and opens it in a new tab; here onOpen hands the match to the app, which navigates. The web meta slot takes any content; detail is a String. The heading level option has no equivalent: the heading is marked as a heading. The heading chooses between a singular and a plural string by count, as on iOS. The parity map named a LazyColumn of cards; it is a Column, because the matches are few and the panel sits inside a scrolling form, where a nested lazy list cannot be measured. The web shows kind, reasons and score on one muted line; here kind and score are badges. The warning icon of the hint is a slot, because Monarch bundles no icons.
accessibility: The heading is marked as a heading. In the hint variant it is a polite live region, so TalkBack announces it when it changes.
The name, badges, reasons and detail of a match are one element and not actionable.
Each button is read as its label and the name of the record, for example "Merge: Example Ltd".
Buttons reserve a 48dp touch target and wrap onto a new line when they do not fit.
The icon is hidden from TalkBack. The score is text, so it does not depend on color.
edgeCases: A score outside 0 to 1 is clamped before it is shown as a percentage.
Long names and reasons wrap; nothing is cut off at the largest font size.
The live region announces changes of the heading, so a change from one to two matches is announced, but a change between two sets of the same size is not.

examples.title: Hint under a create form
examples.template:
MonarchDuplicatePanel(
    matches = listOf(
        MonarchDuplicateMatch(
            id = {{matches.0.id}},
            title = {{matches.0.title}},
            kind = {{matches.0.kind}},
            reasons = listOf({{matches.0.reasons.0}}),
        ),
        MonarchDuplicateMatch(
            id = {{matches.1.id}},
            title = {{matches.1.title}},
            kind = {{matches.1.kind}},
            reasons = listOf({{matches.1.reasons.0}}),
            detail = {{matches.1.meta}},
        ),
    ),
    footer = {{footer}},
    onOpen = {},
)
examples.code:
MonarchDuplicatePanel(
    matches = listOf(
        MonarchDuplicateMatch(
            id = "c1",
            title = "Example Ltd",
            kind = "Client",
            reasons = listOf("Same email"),
        ),
        MonarchDuplicateMatch(
            id = "l7",
            title = "Example Group",
            kind = "Open lead",
            reasons = listOf("Same company domain"),
            detail = "Created last week",
        ),
    ),
    footer = "You can still create it. Merge duplicates later from the record page.",
    onOpen = {},
)

examples.title: A plain section on a record screen
examples.code:
MonarchDuplicatePanel(
    matches = listOf(
        MonarchDuplicateMatch(id = "1", title = "Example Ltd", reasons = listOf("Same name")),
        MonarchDuplicateMatch(id = "2", title = "Example Limited", detail = "Archived"),
    ),
    variant = MonarchDuplicatePanelVariant.Panel,
)
